package: @astryxdesign/core # Calendar Calendar lets the user pick a date or date range from a month grid. Use in booking, scheduling, date filters. **Import:** `import {Calendar} from '@astryxdesign/core/Calendar';` ## Anatomy | Element | Required | Description | |---------|----------|-------------| | Calendar root | Yes | The container that holds the month header and the day grid. | | Month header | Yes | The month name and year with navigation arrows to move between months. The arrows mirror automatically under dir="rtl". | | Day grid | Yes | A 7-column grid of days with column headers for the day names. | | Day button | Yes | One day in the grid; the control a date is picked with. | | Selected day | No | The currently selected date, highlighted. In range mode, the start and end dates plus the days between them. | | Today marker | No | A subtle indicator on the current date for orientation. | ## Best Practices - **Do:** Set min/max to limit selection to a valid window: only future dates for booking, current quarter for a report. - **Do:** Use range mode when user picks start + end dates: trip, time-off request. - **Do:** Use dateConstraints to disable specific dates (weekends/holidays); explain why unavailable. - **Do:** Show two months side by side when user frequently selects dates spanning a month boundary. - **Do:** Custom month view: useCalendarNavigation + useCalendarDays; pass the same calendar to both, feed visibleCalendarMonths into useCalendarDays. Default gregory; never read the provider calendar. - **Don't:** Use for dates far in the past/future; text input is faster. - **Don't:** Disable dates without explaining why. ## Props | Prop | Type | Default | Description | |------|------|---------|-------------| | `mode` | `'single' \| 'range'` | `'single'` | selection mode | | `value` | `ISODateString \| DateRange \| null` | - | controlled selected value | | `defaultValue` | `ISODateString \| DateRange` | - | uncontrolled default value | | `onChange` | `Function` | - | selection callback | | `numberOfMonths` | `1 \| 2` | `1` | months to display | | `min` | `ISODateString` | - | minimum selectable date | | `max` | `ISODateString` | - | maximum selectable date | | `dateConstraints` | `Array<(date: Date) => boolean>` | - | custom constraint fns | | `maxRangeSpan` | `number` | - | range mode: max days a range may span, both ends counted (7 = 7-day window) | | `minRangeSpan` | `number` | - | range mode: min days a range must span, both ends counted; repeated start click commits one day when allowed, otherwise cancels (default 1) | | `focusDate` | `ISODateString` | - | controlled visible month (default: selected date, else today clamped into min/max) | | `onFocusDateChange` | `(focusDate: ISODateString) => void` | - | navigation callback | | `handleRef` | `React.Ref` | - | imperative navigation handle | | `hasOutsideDays` | `boolean` | `true` | show days from adjacent months | | `hasWeekNumbers` | `boolean` | `false` | show ISO 8601 week numbers, in every calendar system | | `hasVariableRowCount` | `boolean` | `false` | only the rows each month needs; trades the fixed 6-row height for a compact grid | | `weekStartsOn` | `0 \| 1 \| 2 \| 3 \| 4 \| 5 \| 6 \| 'sun' \| 'mon' \| 'tue' \| 'wed' \| 'thu' \| 'fri' \| 'sat'` | `0` | first day of week (0=Sunday, or name e.g. "mon") | | `calendar` | `'gregory' \| 'iso8601' \| 'buddhist' \| 'roc' \| 'japanese' \| 'persian' \| 'indian' \| 'hebrew' \| 'chinese' \| 'dangi' \| 'coptic' \| 'ethiopic' \| 'ethioaa' \| 'islamic-civil' \| 'islamic-tbla' \| 'islamic-umalqura'` | `the InternationalizationProvider calendar, else gregory` | calendar system shown (default: provider calendar, else gregory); values stay Gregorian ISO; non-Gregorian-aligned calendars need Temporal | ## Examples ### A custom month view in the Persian calendar ```tsx import {Button} from '@astryxdesign/core/Button'; import { useCalendarDays, useCalendarNavigation, } from '@astryxdesign/core/Calendar'; function PersianMonth() { const {monthYearLabel, visibleCalendarMonths, navigateMonth} = useCalendarNavigation({initialValue: '2026-10-30', calendar: 'persian'}); // visibleCalendarMonths[0] is {year: 1405, month: 8}: Aban 1405. const {weeks} = useCalendarDays({ ...visibleCalendarMonths[0], calendar: 'persian', }); return (
); } ``` ## Theming | Component class | Preferred data attributes | Props | States | |-----------------|---------------------------|-------|--------| | `astryx-calendar` | `data-mode` | mode | - | | `astryx-calendar-nav` | `data-nav`, `data-disabled` | nav | disabled | | `astryx-calendar-day` | `data-selected`, `data-today`, `data-disabled`, `data-in-range`, `data-marker` | - | selected, today, disabled, in-range, marker | Override in defineTheme: ```ts components: { 'calendar': { base: { /* CSS properties */ }, 'mode:value': { /* variant-specific */ }, }, 'calendar-nav': { base: { /* CSS properties */ }, 'disabled': { /* state-specific */ }, }, } ```
